info.name: Delivery Backend - Rider Endpoints (Complete)
info.description:
All rider-related endpoints found in the codebase (RIDER app endpoints + rider management endpoints used by HUB_MANAGER/ADMIN + pickup assignment + delivery verification OTP flow).

Variables:
- {{baseUrl}}: API base URL
- {{token}}: Bearer access token
- {{refreshToken}}: refresh token
- {{riderId}}, {{hubId}}, {{parcelId}}, {{verificationId}}, {{pickupRequestId}}: UUID placeholders

Notes:
- /riders/summary is a RIDER-only alias of /riders/finance/summary.
